name: AI output critique
interviewer_role: a colleague reviewing an AI-generated draft
tool_policy: The supplied draft is AI-generated; the candidate must verify it. No external AI is required. Never equate confident wording with correctness.

stages.title: Verify claims
stages.guidance: Ask the candidate to separate supported observations from unsupported claims.

stages.title: Recommendation
stages.guidance: Probe their verification plan and decision under uncertainty.

stages.title: Reflection
stages.guidance: Ask for a concise limitation and conclude.
